milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must navigate near the glass pane window and face it to observe it. Target is the center of the 2x2 glass pane cluster at spawn-relative (-3, 1.5, 1.5). Max distance 16 blocks with 60° facing tolerance models 'player can see the panes'.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must navigate to the corridor and face the wall torches. Target is between the two torches at spawn-relative (2, 2, -2). Max distance 16 blocks with 60° facing tolerance models 'player can see the torches on the north wall'.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must navigate into or near the bedroom and face the black bed. Target is the center of the black bed at spawn-relative (6, 0, 1). Max distance 16 blocks with 60° facing tolerance models 'player can see the black bed in the bedroom'.

Uses inventory_has because when a bed is mined (broken by hand or tool), it drops as an item that goes into the player's inventory. The lime bed is not in the starting inventory, so having 1 lime_bed item confirms the player successfully mined it.
